Bulk actions work end to end. Open the two versions — they differ only in **how you start selecting**. In **each**:

1. **Select a few** — tick two or three bookmarks. A dark **action bar** appears showing how many are selected.
2. **Act on them together** — press **Mark Finished** (both flip status at once). Try **Add tags** to tag them all in one go, or **Archive**.
3. **Act on a whole result** — type something in search or click a tag to narrow the list, then press **Select all matching (N)** and apply an action to everything that matched.
4. **Delete** asks once to confirm before permanently removing the whole selection.

The two approaches:

- **Option A — a "Select" mode:** http://maker:4001/select-a.html
  Cards stay clean normally; press **Select** in the controls to reveal checkboxes, and **Done selecting** to exit.

- **Option B — checkboxes always shown:** http://maker:4001/select-b.html
  Every card always has a checkbox; ticking any one reveals the action bar.

Assumptions to confirm: **"Select all matching"** picks exactly what your current search/filters show (filter first, then act on all of it); every bulk change (tags, status, archive) applies to the whole selection at once; and **bulk Delete always confirms**.

**Which selection style do you prefer — a Select mode (A) or always-visible checkboxes (B) — and do the bulk actions cover what you need?**
